description: Test N9: can the target-free measure recognise an ideal noisy copy of a reading? No training: loads N7's 20 saved models from Drive (cdt-colab/n7_harder/final), builds from each clean head its ideal noisy copy, and measures them on test-split windows 769-1280. Reads N8's records from cdt-colab/n8_fisher/results for the loading check. About 40 minutes on a T4. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
